## Import rsem
```{r}
library(tximport)

# Base directory for RSEM outputs
rsem_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/005_quant/rsem/sense"

# Dynamically construct paths for each sample
sample_paths <- file.path(rsem_base_dir)

# List all .isoforms.results files
files <- file.path(sample_paths, paste0(sampledata$Sample_id, ".genes.results"))

# Check which files exist
existing_files <- files[file.exists(files)]

# Extract sample IDs - THIS IS THE FIX
# Get the sample IDs from sampledata_version3 that correspond to existing files
file_indices <- which(file.exists(files))
fileSampleIDs <- sampledata$Sample_id[file_indices]

# Create a named vector for tximport with proper sample IDs
names(existing_files) <- fileSampleIDs

# Verify the names are correct
head(names(existing_files))

# Perform tximport for RSEM quantification
txi.rsem <- tximport(existing_files, type = "rsem")

# Check column names now
head(colnames(txi.rsem$counts))
dim(txi.rsem$counts)

# Filter sampledata 
filteredSampleData <- sampledata[sampledata$Sample_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$Sample_id

# Subset txi.rsem
sampleNames <- rownames(filteredSampleData)

# Subset the txi.rsem object
txi.rsem$counts <- txi.rsem$counts[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$abundance <- txi.rsem$abundance[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$length <- txi.rsem$length[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]

# Now extract counts
counts <- txi.rsem$counts
rownames(counts) <-rownames(txi.rsem$counts)
dim(counts)
```
#### Filtering ### 
```{r}
library(edgeR)

colnames(counts) <- (paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Accession, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Replicate,
                                     filteredSampleData$Request_id,filteredSampleData$Sample_id, sep="_"))
# Define variant 
variant <- factor(filteredSampleData$Variant)
genotype <- factor(filteredSampleData$Genotype)
# Remove all-zero genes

#d0 <- d0[rowSums(d0$counts) > 0, ]
d0 <- DGEList(counts = counts, group = genotype)
# Define ddm1 samples
ddm1_samples <- which(d0$samples$group == "ddm1_ct")
# Keep TEs with >= 10 counts in ddm1 samples
keep <- rowSums(d0$counts[, ddm1_samples]) >= 10
# Filter once
d0_filtered <- d0[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
# Normalize
d0_filtered <- calcNormFactors(d0_filtered, method = "TMM")

# Print summary
cat("Total genes before filtering:", nrow(d0), "\n")
cat("Genes retained after filtering:", nrow(d0_filtered), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round(nrow(d0_filtered)/nrow(d0)*100, 1), "%\n")

# Before filtering
log_cpm_before <- cpm(d0, log=TRUE)
# After filtering
log_cpm_after_manual <- cpm(d0_filtered, log=FALSE,normalized.lib.sizes=TRUE)
log_cpm_after_manual <- log2(log_cpm_after_manual+1)
log_cpm_after <- log_cpm_after_manual
# Plot density distributions
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(density(log_cpm_before), main="Before filtering", xlab="log2 counts")
plot(density((log_cpm_after)), main="After filtering", xlab="log2 counts")
```

```{r}
# Create factors 
filteredSampleData$Sequencing_date <- as.factor(filteredSampleData$Sequencing_date)
filteredSampleData$Genotype <- as.factor(filteredSampleData$Genotype)
filteredSampleData$replicate <- as.factor(filteredSampleData$Replicate)
filteredSampleData$Request_id <- as.factor(filteredSampleData$Request_id)
# Set ct_col_6909 as reference for contrasts
filteredSampleData$Genotype <- relevel(filteredSampleData$Genotype, "ct_col")

#  Design, voom, and fit
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Genotype + Sequencing_date+replicate, data = filteredSampleData)
# Apply model and make a plot 
y <- voom(d0_filtered, design, plot = TRUE)
fit <- lmFit(y, design)

# Contrast: F1 ddm1 - F1 Col 
contr <- makeContrasts(ddm1_vs_col = Genotypeddm1_ct- Genotypect_col,
                       levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contr)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
res <- topTable(fit2, coef = "ddm1_vs_col", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
#Mark significant subset of TE
res$gene <- rownames(res)
res$significant <- with(res, adj.P.Val <= 0.05 & logFC >= 1)

tes <- !grepl("AT[1-9]TE", rownames(res)) ##### Select TEs
res_sig_tes <- res[res$significant & tes, ]

# 7) Volcano
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "F1 ddm1 vs F1 Col — limma+voom",
       x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 adjusted p`-value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+ylim(0,50)
```

## Find genes which overlap with TEs
```{r}
library(rtracklayer)
gtf <- import("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")
# Get genes
# subset by type and strand
genes_sense <- gtf[gtf$type == "gene" & strand(gtf) == "+" ]
genes_antisense <- gtf[gtf$type == "gene" & strand(gtf) == "-"]
# Get transposons 
te_sense <- gtf[gtf$type == "transposable_element" & strand(gtf) == "+" ]
te_antisense <- gtf[gtf$type == "transposable_element" & strand(gtf) == "-"]

# Filter TEs
# Sense TEs PCG in the same otientation 
# Anti-sense Tes overlaping PCG in the opposite orientation
library(GenomicRanges)

# Find overlaps
# Sense TEs overlapping sense genes (same orientation = artifact)
sense_overlaps <- findOverlaps(te_sense, genes_sense)
filtered_te_sense <- te_sense[queryHits(sense_overlaps)]

sense_overlaps_genes <- findOverlaps(genes_sense, te_sense)
filtered_genes_sense <- genes_sense[queryHits(sense_overlaps_genes)]

# Antisense TEs overlapping antisense genes (opposite orientation = artifact)
antisense_overlaps <- findOverlaps(te_antisense, genes_sense,ignore.strand = TRUE)
filtered_te_antisense <- te_antisense[queryHits(antisense_overlaps)]

antisense_overlaps_genes <- findOverlaps(genes_sense, te_antisense)
filtered_genes_antisense <- genes_sense[queryHits(antisense_overlaps_genes)]

# Convert to dataframe
filtered_te_sense_df <- as.data.frame(filtered_te_sense) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, seqnames, start, end, strand) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

filtered_te_antisense_df <- as.data.frame(filtered_te_antisense) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, seqnames, start, end, strand) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

filtered_te_antisense_df$ID <- paste(filtered_te_antisense_df$ID,"AS", sep="_")
# Combine
filtered_TEs <- bind_rows(filtered_te_sense_df, filtered_te_antisense_df)


## Genes
filtered_genes_sense_df <- as.data.frame(filtered_genes_sense) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, seqnames, start, end, strand) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Define the subset by metadata 
# Keep genotypes of interest and accession 6909
#####################
###OLD DON'T USE####
#####################
keep_samps <- with(filteredSampleData,
                   Genotype %in% c("ct_col", "F1_ddm1") & Accession == 6909)

# Subset DGEList and metadata in the same order
d1 <- d0_filtered[, keep_samps, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
filteredSampleData$sample <- (paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Accession, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Replicate,
                                     filteredSampleData$Request_id,filteredSampleData$Sample_id, sep="_"))
sd <- droplevels(filteredSampleData[keep_samps, ])

stopifnot(identical(colnames(d1), sd$sample))

# Batch and group factors
sd$Sequencing.date <- factor(gsub("-", "_", sd$Sequencing.date))
sd$group <- factor(paste(sd$Genotype, sd$Accession, sep = "_"))
sd$replicate <- factor(sd$Replicate)
# Set ct_col_6909 as reference for contrasts
if ("ct_col_6909" %in% levels(sd$group)) {
  sd$group <- relevel(sd$group, "ct_col_6909")
}

# 3) Re-filter for expression on the final sample set (important)
keep2 <- filterByExpr(d1, group = sd$group)
d1 <- d1[keep2, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
d1 <- calcNormFactors(d1)
d0_filtered
#  Design, voom, and fit
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + Sequencing.date+replicate, data = sd)
# If sample quality varies, consider voomWithQualityWeights(d1, design, plot = TRUE)
y <- voom(d1, design, plot = TRUE)
fit <- lmFit(y, design)

# Contrast: ddm1_ct_6909 vs ct_col_6909
contr <- makeContrasts(ddm1_vs_col = groupct_ddm1_6909_s_6909 - groupct_col_6909,
                       levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contr)
# You can use eBayes, or use treat to test against a fold-change threshold
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
# fit2 <- treat(fit2, lfc = log2(2))  # optional: test |log2FC| >= 1

res <- topTable(fit2, coef = "ddm1_vs_col", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

# 6) Mark significant and (optional) TE-only subset
res$gene <- rownames(res)
res$significant <- with(res, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 1)
tes_mask <- grepl("AT[1-9]TE", rownames(res))
res_sig_tes <- res[res$significant & tes_mask, ]

# 7) Volcano
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(adj.P.Val))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "ddm1_ct vs ct_col (Accession 6909) — limma+voom",
       x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 adjusted p-value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

```

```{r}
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+ylim(0,50)
```

## Find genes which overlap with TEs
```{r}
library(rtracklayer)
gtf <- import("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")
# Get genes
# subset by type and strand
genes_sense <- gtf[gtf$type == "gene" & strand(gtf) == "+" ]
genes_antisense <- gtf[gtf$type == "gene" & strand(gtf) == "-"]
# Get transposons 
te_sense <- gtf[gtf$type == "transposable_element" & strand(gtf) == "+" ]
te_antisense <- gtf[gtf$type == "transposable_element" & strand(gtf) == "-"]

# Filter TEs
# Sense TEs PCG in the same otientation 
# Anti-sense Tes overlaping PCG in the opposite orientation
library(GenomicRanges)

# Find overlaps
# Sense TEs overlapping sense genes (same orientation = artifact)
sense_overlaps <- findOverlaps(te_sense, genes_sense)
filtered_te_sense <- te_sense[queryHits(sense_overlaps)]

# Antisense TEs overlapping antisense genes (opposite orientation = artifact)
antisense_overlaps <- findOverlaps(te_antisense, genes_antisense)
filtered_te_antisense <- te_antisense[queryHits(antisense_overlaps)]

# Convert to dataframe
filtered_te_sense_df <- as.data.frame(filtered_te_sense) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, seqnames, start, end, strand) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

filtered_te_antisense_df <- as.data.frame(filtered_te_antisense) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, seqnames, start, end, strand) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Combine
filtered_TEs <- bind_rows(filtered_te_sense_df, filtered_te_antisense_df)
```
# Filter TEs 
```{r}
summary(rownames(res_sig_tes) %in% filtered_TEs$ID)
```
